section1.content: These Terms of Service govern the relationship between the Shadow Proxy service (hereinafter — "Service") and the User when using proxy services. By registering in the Service or using it, you confirm your agreement with these terms. The Service provides access to residential, mobile, and IPv6 proxies for legal use. It is prohibited to use proxies for illegal activities, spam, fraud, or bypassing blocks for the purpose of violating the rights of third parties.

section2.title: 2. Payment and Refunds
section2.content: Payment for services is made in accordance with the tariffs specified on the website. Prices are indicated in US dollars. After payment, funds are credited to the user's balance and can be used to purchase proxies. Refunds are not provided after successful proxy issuance. In case of a technical error or inability to provide the service, the administration reserves the right to make a refund at its discretion.
